page_title: NAN 1-1 LYO | Nantes v Lyon 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Marcus Coco (Nantes).
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matthis Abline departs the field of play to be replaced by Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes).
90+2' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Moses Simon sends a long raking pass onto the head of Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
88' VAR review of the penalty decision hasn’t taken long and it’s NO PENALTY! The Nantes players are stunned.
87' There's a break in play and referee Benoit Bastien must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Nantes using VAR. This could be interesting!
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.

85' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the left side of the goal and Lucas Perri easily plucks the ball out of the air.
83' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
81' The corner from Thiago Almada (Lyon) is cleared away by the defence.
78' Substitution. Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes) in, Kelvin Amian out.
78' Antoine Kombouare has decided to substitute Nicolas Cozza and he is replaced by Louis Leroux (Nantes).
74' Moses Simon (Nantes) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
73' Substitution. Sael Kumbedi did his best and is replaced by Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon).
72' Moses Simon (Nantes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Nantes are awarded a corner kick.
69' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) replacing Bahereba Guirassy.
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Florent Mollet as he is replaced by Marcus Coco (Nantes).
68' Thiago Almada (Lyon) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
68' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner.

65' Matthis Abline (Nantes) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Lucas Perri, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alexandre Lacazette will be replaced by Georges Mikautadze (Lyon).
64' The substitution has been made. Thiago Almada (Lyon) has replaced Rayan Cherki.
63' Matthis Abline (Nantes) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
62' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Moses Simon (Nantes), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
62' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) brings an opponent down and Benoit Bastien interrupts the game.
59' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
59' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

58' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a superb save! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lyon.
57' Florent Mollet (Nantes) gets booked for the first time in this match.
57' Moses Simon (Nantes) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Lucas Perri anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
55' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
48' Moses Simon (Nantes) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
48' Matthis Abline (Nantes) commits a foul and Benoit Bastien immediately signals a free kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Benoit Bastien has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+4' OFF THE POST! Rayan Cherki (Lyon) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
45+4' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

45+3' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

45+3' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the top right corner. Anthony Lopes shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) makes a strong challenge and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul.
43' Clinton Mata (Lyon) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
42' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
40' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:2.
37' Clinton Mata (Lyon) sends a long ball forward to Sael Kumbedi, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
34' The resulting corner from Moses Simon (Nantes) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
31' Moses Simon (Nantes) has a goal ruled out for offside!
30' The Lyon players are exchanging some short passes.
26' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
23' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
19' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
16' A rebound spins to Florent Mollet (Nantes) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
13' Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
10' 0 - 1 It's 0:1! Nicolas Tagliafico feeds Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the right side of the net.
7' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.

5' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) latches on to a lofted pass from the resulting set piece and pulls the trigger from around the penalty spot. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by the excellent Anthony Lopes.
5' It seemed like Rayan Cherki (Lyon) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
4' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
2' One of the Nantes players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Nantes will kick the game off.
Benoit Bastien will officiate today.
